metadata.question: Were there two isolated islands within a 2 km radius of (27.245974, 140.878144) on March 30, 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point (27.245974, 140.878144) with 2 km buffer - Date: March 30, 2014 (single day, may need to expand if no data) - Collection: Need to identify land/water. Landsat 8 available from 2013+, or use water detection indices 2. Masking strategy: - Need to identify land pixels (islands) vs water - Use water indices like NDWI or water classification - May need cloud masking if clouds present 3. Logic for answer: - Need to detect exactly 2 isolated land masses (islands) - Use connected components analysis to count separate islands - Valid result = A (yes, 2 islands) or B (no, not 2 islands) - C1 if no imagery available - C2 if all pixels masked/invalid - C3 if calculation fails ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry and time const point = ee.Geometry.Point([140.878144, 27.245974]); const aoi = point.buffer(2000); // 2 km radius const date = '2014-03-30'; // 2. Try Landsat 8 first let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')); let size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images on ${date}: ${size}`); // If no Landsat 8, try Landsat 7 if (size === 0) { collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')); size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 7 images on ${date}: ${size}`); } // If still no data, expand date range if (size === 0) { collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2014-03-25', '2014-04-05'); size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images (expanded): ${size}`); } if (size === 0) { console.log('No imagery available for the location and time period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Get the first image and apply cloud mask const image = collection.first(); // Cloud masking for Landsat 8 const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); // 4. Calculate NDWI to identify water const green = image.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const nir = image.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const ndwi = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).updateMask(cloudMask); // Land is where NDWI < 0 (not water) const land = ndwi.lt(0).selfMask().clip(aoi); // Check valid pixels const pixelCount = land.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B3').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid land pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0 || pixelCount === null) { console.log('No valid land pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Connected components to count islands const connected = land.connectedComponents({ connectedness: ee.Kernel.plus(1), maxSize: 256 }); const labels = connected.select('labels'); // Count unique labels (islands) const islandCount = labels.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.countDistinct(), geometry: aoi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('labels').getInfo(); console.log(`Number of isolated islands: ${islandCount}`); if (islandCount === null || islandCount === undefined) { console.log('Failed to calculate island count.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Final answer if (islandCount === 2) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
